title: Security Engineer II (AI)
jobDescription: At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. This is a builder's role at the frontier of a fast-moving field handson, high-ownership, and directly influential in making responsible AI adoption real at a global scale. If you are excited about defining what secure AI looks like inside a world-class organisation, apply now and become part of Team Orange.

You will work at the cutting edge of platform engineering, in a high-ownership environment where your contributions shape how AI is built and deployed across the entire organisation. If you are passionate about innovative AI platforms and want to make a real impact, apply now and become part of Team Orange!

title: Staff Data Engineer
jobDescription: The central Business Intelligence team at SIXT builds and maintains the SIXT Data Platform and its Data Catalogue, serving thousands of users globally. Our flagship product, the SIXT Data Shop, ingests tens of millions of events daily and delivers insights through a comprehensive toolbox — from self-service batch processes to real-time ML model endpoints. You will join a hands-on, collaborative team of Data Engineers and BI Engineers who are constantly pushing cutting-edge technologies forward, with a strong focus on operational automation, ETL workflows, and innovative customer use cases. At SIXT, we value success, agility, ownership, and intercultural collaboration — apply now and become part of Team Orange.
